name: year
description: Calendar year of the record date

name: record_date
description: Last day of the quarter the exchange rate reports

name: effective_date
description: Date the exchange rate takes effect for reporting purposes
observations: May differ from record_date when a rate is revised mid-quarter

name: country
description: Country whose currency the rate converts
observations: Free-text English country name; the source carries no ISO code, so no directory link

name: currency
description: Currency the rate converts to U.S. dollars

name: country_currency_desc
description: Country and currency combined, as published by the Treasury
observations: Unique with record_date; some countries report more than one currency

name: exchange_rate
description: Units of the foreign currency per one U.S. dollar, the Treasury reporting rate
observations: Unit varies by row (foreign currency per USD), so no single column-level measurement unit applies
